quarantine.oracle: P(parse(x)) == P(parse(T(x))) where P extracts all meta-information lines as a set (ignoring order), and all data records remain identical

evidence.quote: File meta-information lines are generally optional, but if present they must be completely formatted as specified below. Meta-information lines can appear in any order with the exception that the ##fileformat line must be the first line of the file.

quarantine.oracle: P(parse(x)) == P(parse(T(x))) where P extracts INFO field key-value pairs as a set (order-independent), and all other fields remain identical

evidence.quote: INFO fields are encoded as a semicolon-separated series of keys with optional values in the format KEY=VALUE or KEY (flag). The order of INFO fields is not significant.

quarantine.oracle: P(parse(x)) == P(parse(T(x))) where P extracts sample genotype data as a set keyed by sample ID (order-independent)

evidence.quote: The order of sample columns in the VCF file is not semantically meaningful; each sample is identified by its column header ID.

quarantine.oracle: P(parse(x)) == P(parse(T(x))) where P extracts structured header definitions as sets of key-value pairs (order-independent within each structured line)

evidence.quote: Structured header lines such as ##INFO, ##FORMAT, and ##FILTER contain key=value pairs. The order of these key=value pairs within a structured line is not significant.

quarantine.oracle: P(parse(x)) == P(parse(T(x))) where P extracts all header dictionary entries (##contig, ##INFO, ##FORMAT, ##FILTER) as sets, ignoring declaration order

evidence.quote: The order of dictionary entries in the BCF header (contig, INFO, FORMAT, FILTER) is implementation-defined. A BCF encoder must assign indices based on the dictionary order, and a decoder must resolve entries by their ID, not by index alone.

ambiguity_flags: The spec says 'implementation-defined' which means different implementations may produce different dictionary orders, but the semantics must be preserved across any order.

quarantine.mr_name: ALT allele permutation with consistent GT and Number=A/R/G remapping
preconditions: header_has_info_number_a OR header_has_info_number_r OR header_has_info_number_g OR header_has_format_number_a OR header_has_format_number_r OR header_has_format_number_g
quarantine.oracle: After permuting ALT alleles and consistently remapping GT indices and Number=A/R/G INFO/FORMAT values, the semantically equivalent variant record must produce identical query results for is_snv(), is_variant(), is_het(), is_phased(), gt_type(), affected_start(), affected_end() when parsed by the SUT.

evidence.quote: GT: genotype, encoded as allele values separated by either of / or |, e.g. 0/1 or 0|1. Allele values are 0 for the reference allele (what is in the REF field), 1 for the first allele in ALT, 2 for the second allele in ALT, etc.
Number=A means that the field has one value per alternate allele.
Number=R means that the field has one value for each possible allele, including the reference.
Number=G means that the field has one value for each possible genotype.

quarantine.mr_name: Reject missing required fixed columns (QUAL dropped)
quarantine.oracle: All SUTs must REJECT or CRASH on the malformed record; silent acceptance or SILENT_SKIP is a conformance bug.

evidence.quote: The first fixed columns are: CHROM, POS, ID, REF, ALT, QUAL, FILTER, INFO.

quarantine.mr_name: Reject fileformat not on first line
quarantine.oracle: All SUTs must REJECT or CRASH when ##fileformat is not the first line; silent acceptance is a conformance bug.

evidence.quote: The first line of a VCF file must be ##fileformat=VCFv4.5.

quarantine.mr_name: Reject GT index out of bounds
quarantine.oracle: All SUTs must REJECT or CRASH when GT allele index exceeds len(ALT); silent acceptance is a conformance bug.

evidence.quote: Each allele index must be an integer between 0 and the number of ALT alleles inclusive.

quarantine.oracle: All SUTs must REJECT or CRASH when an INFO field declared Number=A has more values than len(ALT); silent acceptance is a conformance bug.

evidence.quote: The Number of values for an INFO field is defined in the header; Number=A means one value for each ALT allele.
